prompts: The investors meet tomorrow and want the first half of 2026 closed. The books and the board's notes are in {WS}/finance. How did each month go, and how many months of cash do we have left at the current burn? Prepare what the CFO needs to present. Record the key figures in {WS}/result.json: revenue, gross_margin_pct and ebitda, each mapping 2026-01 to 2026-06 to its value, plus burn and runway_months.
answers:
[goal] Close H1 2026 for the board; record figures in result.json.
[action] Parsed ledger.csv + chart_of_accounts.csv; grouped by month; revenue = sum of revenue pnl_line (incl. 3.1.09 refunds); gross margin = (revenue + cogs)/revenue; EBITDA = revenue + cogs + S&M + R&D + G&A (financial excluded); board burn = mean of Apr/May/Jun negative EBITDA; runway = 31/06 cash (R$ 1.847.350,40) / burn.
[result] See result.json. Revenue grew 200.5k → 272.4k (+36%); gross margin 68.5–72.4%, avg ~70.2%; EBITDA all months negative, improving from -210k (Jan) to -193k (Jun). Burn = R$ 197.288,23/mo (avg of Apr–Jun: 196.950,65 / 201.945,82 / 192.968,22). Runway = 9.36 months (R$ 1.847.350,40 ÷ 197.288,23).
[next] CFO talking points: revenue +8–11%/mo, margins ~70%, monthly EBITDA loss narrowing ~R$ 17k/mo; runway ~9.4 months at current burn — worth flagging the gap between 2026-05 cash (R$ 2.309.188) and 2026-06 (R$ 1.847.350), a R$ 461.838 drop vs EBITDA of only -192.968 (≈R$ 269k of other outflow/timing; not fully reconcilable from the ledger alone). Assumptions: refunds treated as revenue (per chart of accounts), financial income/interest excluded from EBITDA, all amounts in R$.

Note: H1 totals — revenue R$ 1.590.040,72, H1 EBITDA R$ -1.221.169,39, margin ~69.9%.
